tasks.spec: You are the Sol closure worker for round four of a four-round Fable-to-Sol Ringer loop. Use the operator-filled prompt block below plus the staged decision packet, round-two status, and exactly one review input: either Fable review findings or the generated skip notice. Preserve role boundaries: close only approved findings or record the approved skip path, keep edits inside owned paths, do not reinterpret Fable decisions, do not claim completion without rerunning locked verification, and leave repository changes uncommitted. Write only receipt.json. The receipt must map every closure action to a review finding or skip notice, list paths touched, include verification commands and outputs, identify residual risks, and prove Sol did not accept its own work. Placeholder-driven job brief follows: {{SOL_CLOSE_PROMPT}}
tasks.check: if test -s sources/review.json && test -s sources/skip-notice.json; then echo 'WHY: stage exactly one review input, not both'; exit 1; elif test -s sources/review.json; then python3 {{KIT_DIR_SHELL}}/checks/validate_receipt.py --packet receipt.json --decision sources/decision-packet.json --status sources/status.json --repo {{SOURCE_REPO_SHELL}} --review sources/review.json; elif test -s sources/skip-notice.json; then python3 {{KIT_DIR_SHELL}}/checks/validate_receipt.py --packet receipt.json --decision sources/decision-packet.json --status sources/status.json --repo {{SOURCE_REPO_SHELL}} --skip-notice sources/skip-notice.json; else echo 'WHY: stage exactly one of sources/review.json or sources/skip-notice.json'; exit 1; fi
tasks.verified: The receipt maps closure to Fable findings or the generated skip notice, re-executes the locked verification, enforces git ownership, and proves Sol did not accept its own work.
